label: Nissan GT-R (R35, 2009)
sources: https://autoprove.net (Japanese spec sheet via search summary; GR6 ratios)
notes: Firing order 1-2-3-4-5-6 is from Nissan's R35 manual (manualsdir) and rerev. Which bank holds 1,3,5 is NOT confirmed: rerev text and diagram conflict (driver side vs passenger side); Nissan manual gives no numbering. Treat bank A=[1,3,5], B=[2,4,6] as unverified; left/right unknown. Crank type not stated in any source (null). Boost: Wikipedia says 'more than 0.7 bar' (floor, not a peak). Torque: Wikipedia lists 583 Nm (2007-09) and 588 Nm (2009-10), plateau 3200-5200 rpm; used 588. Idle: Nissan manual says no adjustment needed, no rpm published. Rear tyre 285/35ZRF20 is from the Nissan Japan NISMO spec sheet via search summary; carexpert lists 285/35 R20 for base. Gear ratios/final drive 3.700 (rear) from Japanese spec sheets via search-result summaries, I did not read the PDF directly; reverse 3.383, front final 2.937. Frontal area not found. Gear cut not found. Curb 1740 kg is the 2007-09 figure (Wikipedia).

label: Subaru Impreza WRX STI (GRB, EJ257, 6MT)
notes: Firing order 1-3-2-4 per Wikipedia. Bank assignment: one secondary source says 1,3 passenger side and 2,4 driver side; another low-quality page conflicts; unverified, left/right unknown. Wikipedia gives displacement 2,457 cc, redline 6700 rpm for EJ257. Power/torque are 2008 US figures (305 hp @6000 = 227 kW; 290 lb-ft = 393 Nm @4000) from carspecs, not JDM/EU ratings. Gear ratios are rounded to 2 dp from carspecs (the 3.636/2.375/1.761... set seen on an oakos page is the 2004 car, not used; note my earlier second gear 2.375 differs from carspecs 2.23). Curb weight 3,395 lb = 1,540 kg (carspecs, wagon/hatch). Turbo count (single) and boost not sourced, so null. Idle, Cd, frontal area not found. Aspiration 'turbo' per Wikipedia 'turbocharged'.

label: Audi RS3 (8Y, 2022, 7-speed S tronic)
notes: Firing order 1-2-4-5-3 from Audi's press page. Displacement 2,480 cc and code from auto-data (the 'DNWC' code is auto-data's, not Audi's page). Power 294 kW (400 PS) is a plateau 5600-7000 rpm, powerRpm=5600 is the start; torque 500 Nm plateau 2250-5600. Turbo count 1 is my reading of 'a turbocharger' (auto-data/cararac 'Turbocharger: Yes'); Audi release does not give count. NOT FOUND: S tronic gear ratios, final drive, peak boost, redline, idle, frontal area (all null/empty). Curb 1570 kg without driver (Audi). Rear tyre 265/30R19 per cararac; auto-data lists front 265/30 and rear 245/35 (apparently swapped), so tyre uncertain. Cd 0.34 only from auto-data.

label: Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG (2011, M159)
notes: Firing order 1-5-4-2-6-3-7-8 and 7,200 rpm 'Maximum engine speed' are from the 2011 SLS AMG owner's manual (manualsonline). Other forum sources cite 1-5-4-8-6-3-7-2 for Mercedes V8s generally; I trust the manual. Crank type not stated anywhere I read; 'cross-plane' is my inference because the order does not alternate banks, with Mercedes numbering (1-4 one bank, 5-8 other) per forum posts only: bank split and which is left/right are UNVERIFIED. Wikipedia M156 table says 7,250 rpm for M159 (conflict with 7,200; used manual). Gear ratios/final 3.67 from carspecs (and a Mercedes press table via search summary); reverse 2.79. DCT: AMG SPEEDSHIFT DCT 7-speed (Getrag 7DCL750). Curb 1,619 kg coupe (Wikipedia; carspecs 3,573 lb=1,621). Dry-sump. NOT FOUND: idle, Cd, frontal area, gear cut.

label: Volkswagen Beetle 1600 (Type 1, early 1970s, 4MT)
notes: Power/torque/mass/tyre are the 1970-72 VW 1302 data (kfz-tech): 37 kW (50 PS) @4000, 106 Nm @2800 (1600 engine), 870 kg kerb, 5.60-15 standard. Firing order 1-4-3-2 per Wikipedia firing-order table; banks 1,2 / 3,4 from ONE weak source (unverified, left/right unknown). Gear ratios 3.80/2.06/1.26/0.89 and final 3.875 are the Limebug gearbox code 'AU' (1303S/LSD) via a search summary, I could not read the full table; German 1600 factory is 3.875, but 4.375 is used on 1200/1300 and Mexican cars (conflict). 3.80/2.06 matches a Type 181 page for 1970-Feb 1973. Cd 0.48 is Wikipedia's generic Beetle figure. Idle/redline (no limiter on a Type 1), frontal area not found.
